title: Insecure Data Sharing
description: The parent user may inadvertently share sensitive information (email, password, name, govt ID) in an insecure manner, leading to unauthorized access or data breaches.

title: Data Interception
description: Data in transit (registration information) could be intercepted by malicious actors, leading to unauthorized access to personal information.

title: Data Misuse by Service
description: The Authentication Service may misuse the collected data (email, password, name, govt ID) for purposes other than intended, such as selling it to third parties.

title: Data Retention Risks
description: The Authentication Service may retain personal data longer than necessary, increasing the risk of exposure in case of a data breach.

title: Inadequate Authentication Mechanism
description: The authentication service may have weak authentication mechanisms, allowing unauthorized access to the parent account data.

title: Data Breach due to Insecure Storage
description: The MongoDB users collection may be vulnerable to data breaches if not properly secured, leading to unauthorized access to sensitive parent account information.

title: Data Leakage during Transmission
description: Data transmitted from the authentication service to the MongoDB may be intercepted, leading to unauthorized access to parent account information.

title: Data Leakage through JWT
description: The authentication service may inadvertently expose sensitive user data embedded in the JWT if proper encryption or signing mechanisms are not implemented.

title: Identity Theft
description: The parent user may be at risk of identity theft if the JWT is intercepted or if the user data is mishandled after receipt.

title: Non-repudiation Issues
description: If the JWT is not properly logged or if there is no mechanism to verify the authenticity of the data flow, it may lead to non-repudiation issues, making it difficult to prove the legitimacy of the transaction.

title: Insecure Data Sharing
description: The child user shares sensitive information (parent email and password) without ensuring the security of the communication channel.

title: Data Interception
description: Data in transit (parent email and password) could be intercepted by an unauthorized party during the login process.

title: Unauthorized Access to Data
description: The authentication service may store or process the parent email and password insecurely, leading to unauthorized access.

title: Insufficient Authentication Strength
description: The authentication service may not enforce strong enough authentication mechanisms for child users, leading to unauthorized access to sensitive child profiles.

title: Insecure Data Storage
description: Child profiles may be stored insecurely at the destination, making them vulnerable to unauthorized access or data breaches.

title: Data Leakage in Transit
description: JWT tokens containing sensitive information may be intercepted during transmission, leading to potential data leakage.

title: Unintended Data Sharing
description: Child users may unintentionally share their profiles with unauthorized parties due to lack of awareness or understanding of privacy settings.

title: Inadequate Consent
description: The parent user may not have provided adequate consent for the collection of sensitive information about the child, such as government ID and date of birth.

title: Data Misuse
description: The child profile management process may misuse the collected data for purposes other than those originally intended, such as marketing or profiling.

title: Data Leakage
description: There is a risk of data leakage during the transmission of sensitive information from the parent user to the child profile management process, potentially exposing it to unauthorized parties.

title: Insecure Data Storage
description: The child profile management process may store sensitive data insecurely, making it vulnerable to unauthorized access or breaches.

title: Inadequate Consent Management
description: The process may not adequately manage consent from parents or guardians for storing and updating child profiles, leading to unauthorized data processing.

title: Data Breach Risk
description: The MongoDB childprofiles collection may be vulnerable to data breaches, exposing sensitive child profile information to unauthorized parties.

title: Inadequate Data Retention Policies
description: The data stored in the MongoDB collection may not have adequate retention policies, leading to unnecessary storage of personal data beyond its intended purpose.

title: Data Misuse by Insiders
description: Insiders with access to the MongoDB childprofiles collection may misuse the data for unauthorized purposes, such as identity theft or profiling.

title: Unintentional Data Sharing
description: The child user may unintentionally share personal information while interacting with the video management service, such as through comments or likes that reveal their identity or preferences.

title: Inadequate Data Anonymization
description: The video management service may inadequately anonymize user data, allowing for the identification of child users based on their interactions, such as search queries or comments.

title: Data Leakage in Transit
description: Data transmitted between the child user and the video management service may be intercepted, leading to unauthorized access to personal information.

title: Excessive Data Retention
description: The video management service may retain user data longer than necessary, increasing the risk of exposure or misuse of child user information.

title: User Control Over Data
description: Child users may lack sufficient control over their data, including the ability to delete comments or likes, leading to potential privacy violations.

title: Unauthorized Access to Video Metadata
description: An unauthorized user may gain access to the video metadata being shared by the Video Management Service, leading to potential privacy violations.

title: Insecure Storage of Video Files
description: The MongoDB videos collection may not have adequate security measures in place, leading to potential data breaches and unauthorized access to sensitive video files.

title: Data Retention Issues
description: The video metadata and files may be retained longer than necessary, leading to potential privacy concerns regarding the storage of personal data.

title: Metadata Leakage During Transmission
description: Metadata about the video files may be exposed during transmission between the Video Management Service and the MongoDB collection, potentially revealing sensitive information about users.

title: Inadequate Consent Management
description: The process may not adequately inform parents or guardians about the data being collected, leading to a lack of informed consent for storing child search and watch history.

title: Data Retention Risks
description: The MongoDB childprofiles collection may retain child search and watch history longer than necessary, increasing the risk of unauthorized access or misuse.

title: Insufficient Access Controls
description: The destination element may lack sufficient access controls, allowing unauthorized personnel to access sensitive child profiles.

title: Data Leakage in Transit
description: There is a risk of data leakage during the transmission of child search and watch history to the MongoDB collection, potentially exposing sensitive information.

title: Inadequate Consent
description: The parent user may not fully understand or provide informed consent for the data being uploaded, leading to potential misuse of their personal information.

title: Data Misuse by Service Provider
description: The Video Management Service may misuse the uploaded videos or associated metadata for purposes other than what was agreed upon, such as selling data to third parties.

title: Data Leakage during Transmission
description: There is a risk of data leakage during the transmission of video uploads, which could expose sensitive information to unauthorized parties.

title: Insecure Data Storage
description: The Video Management Service may store uploaded videos insecurely, making them vulnerable to unauthorized access or breaches.

title: Unauthorized Access to Video Stream
description: The Video Management Service may inadvertently allow unauthorized users to access the video stream intended for the child user, leading to potential exposure of sensitive content.

title: Inappropriate Use of Video Content
description: The child user may misuse the video content after receiving it, such as sharing it with others or using it inappropriately, which could lead to privacy violations.

title: Metadata Leakage
description: During the streaming process, metadata about the child user or the video content may be exposed, which could be used to identify or track the child user.

title: Unauthorized Data Sharing
description: The child browsing data may be shared without proper consent from the guardians, leading to unauthorized access to sensitive information.

title: Inaccurate Data Processing
description: The AI Recommendation Engine may process the child browsing data inaccurately, leading to inappropriate recommendations or actions based on misinterpreted data.

title: Data Retention Risks
description: The AI engine may retain child browsing data longer than necessary, increasing the risk of data breaches or misuse.

title: Data Leakage in Transit
description: There is a risk of data leakage during the transmission of child browsing data to the AI engine, potentially exposing sensitive information to unauthorized parties.

title: Inadequate Consent Management
description: The AI Recommendation Engine may share browsing data with third-party advertisers without obtaining proper consent from users, leading to unauthorized data sharing.

title: Inadequate Data Protection Measures
description: Third-party advertisers may not implement adequate security measures to protect the browsing data received, leading to potential data breaches or unauthorized access.

title: Data Linkability
description: The browsing data shared may contain identifiers that allow third-party advertisers to link the data back to individual users, compromising user anonymity.

title: Misuse of Data
description: Third-party advertisers may use the browsing data for purposes beyond what was originally intended or disclosed to users, leading to privacy violations.

title: Unauthorized Access to Government ID Images
description: An unauthorized user may gain access to the authentication service and submit a request to store government ID images, leading to potential data breaches.

title: Insecure Storage of Government ID Images
description: The file system may not have adequate security measures in place, leading to unauthorized access or data leaks of sensitive government ID images.

title: Data Interception During Transmission
description: Data being transmitted from the authentication service to the file system may be intercepted by malicious actors, exposing sensitive government ID images.

title: Insufficient Authentication Strength
description: The authentication service may use weak algorithms or insufficiently complex passwords, making it easier for attackers to gain unauthorized access to the JWT stored in localStorage.

title: Insecure Storage of JWT
description: Storing JWT in localStorage can expose it to cross-site scripting (XSS) attacks, where an attacker can inject malicious scripts to access the token.

title: Data Leakage through LocalStorage
description: The JWT stored in localStorage may be accessible to other scripts running on the same domain, leading to potential data leakage.

title: Unauthorized Access to JWT
description: If the localStorage is not properly secured, unauthorized users or scripts may gain access to the JWT, leading to unauthorized actions on behalf of the user.

title: Unauthorized Access to Child Profile
description: A parent may gain unauthorized access to sensitive child profile information if proper authentication mechanisms are not in place.

title: Inadequate Data Handling by Parent
description: The parent may mishandle or misuse the child profile information after retrieval, leading to potential privacy violations.

title: Data Leakage During Transmission
description: There is a risk of data leakage during the transmission of child profile information, which could expose sensitive data to unauthorized parties.

title: Retention of Child Data
description: The parent may retain child profile information longer than necessary, leading to potential privacy risks.

title: Unclear Data Sharing Policies
description: The policies regarding data sharing between the child profile management system and the parent may be unclear, leading to misunderstandings about data usage.
